messages:
maria: Quick question — deploybot put a security hold on release v2.14.0 (transitive libX CVE). Sec team said conditional OK if reviewer rotation is in place. Can we lift the hold?

devin: Which CVE number and what's the conditional?

maria: CVE-2025-8432. Condition: two independent reviewers sign off on the mitigation and we add the rationale to release notes + 48h post-release monitoring. Sec already stamped the mitigation as acceptable for now.

jenna: I can do the first review now. tagging @sam for second reviewer.

sam: I can take it in ~30m. do we need extra tests or just the dependency pin + rollout plan?

maria: We need a temporary pin to 1.2.3 for the affected module, canary to 10% for first 6 hours, rollback triggers on error rate >3% or increased latency. Add note under "Security" in release notes.

devin: Fine. Once both reviews are in, should deploybot be allowed to auto-lift or do we lift manually?

jenna: prefer auto-lift with an explicit reviewer tag pattern. e.g. /deploybot lift-hold --approvals jenna,sam --reason "CVE-2025-8432 mitigation + pin"

sam: agree. automation avoids manual step at 2am for other regions. make sure audit log records reviewers.

secops-bot: SecOps: approval validated. reviewers jenna, sam. Note: mitigation is documented in internal ticket #SEC-412.

deploybot: Automated check: SBOM scan OK (minor transitive flagged), license scan OK. Waiting on deploy policy "reviewer-rotation" approval.

maria: jenna + sam both approved in thread. moving to run the lift command in 5. will also add the audit blurb to release notes.

jenna: took screenshots of the diff and test runs, uploaded to the release artifact.

devin: small nit — instead of pinning forever, add a task to track upstream fix and mark for dep-upgrade in 2 weeks. otherwise we'll accumulate tech debt.

maria: agreed. I'll create a follow-up ticket and add it to the release checklist.

sam: running the lift now:```/deploybot lift-hold --release v2.14.0 --approvals jenna,sam --reason "CVE-2025-8432 mitigation verified"```

deploybot: hold lifted for v2.14.0. Canary 10% started. Monitoring rules applied. Audit: approvers=jenna,sam; note=mitigation + pin.

maria: thanks. leaving 48h watch with alert on error/latency. tagging @oncall for the period.

devin: add a short line in public release notes: "Mitigation applied for a transitive vulnerability (CVE-2025-8432); temporarily pinned module X pending upstream fix." keep it high level.

maria: done. internal release notes include the full risk analysis and link to SEC-412.

sam: closing loop — create a follow-up in 14 days to upgrade the pinned dep once upstream releases fix.

jenna: thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: closing thread.
